# Erdos.p337 — Erdős problem 337

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/337
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/337.lean`, theorem `erdos_337.variants.ruzsa_turjanyi`, AMS 5 11).

Ruzsa and Turjányi do prove (under the same hypotheses) that
$$
\lim_{N\to \infty}\frac{\lvert (A+A+A)\cap \{1,\ldots,3N\}\rvert}
{\lvert A\cap \{1,\ldots,N\}\rvert}=\infty,
$$
and conjecture that the same should be true with $(A+A)\cap \{1,\ldots,2N\}$ in the numerator.

## Statement
∀ A : Set ℕ, A.IsAsymptoticAddBasis →
      (fun N : ℕ ↦ ((A ∩ Icc 1 N).ncard : ℝ)) =o[atTop] (fun N : ℕ ↦ (N : ℝ)) →
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦
          (((A + A) ∩ Icc 1 (2 * N)).ncard : ℝ) / ((A ∩ Icc 1 N).ncard : ℝ))
        atTop atTop

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
